title: Mexicana Black Bean Tacos
subtitle: with Avocado Salsa and Vegan Feta
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Check your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe (see Kitchen notes). Drain and rinse half the beans.

Make bean filling: Combine the beans, tomatoes, Tex-Mex seasoning and 1 tbs tomato paste in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 mins or until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Make avocado salsa: Meanwhile, cut the avocado into small chunks. Combine 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp white wine vinegar in a bowl. Add the avocado, season with salt and pepper and gently toss to coat.
Warm tortillas: Put the tortillas on a plate, slightly overlapping, and microwave for 30 secs or until warmed through (see Kitchen notes).
Serve up: Crumble the vegan feta. Divide the tortillas among plates. Top with the bean filling, avocado salsa and vegan feta. Drizzle with the vegan mayonnaise and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: To speed up the ripening process, put the avocado in a paper bag with a banana and close loosely, then leave on the kitchen bench for a day or two. ~ If you don't have a microwave, heat a large frypan over medium-high heat. Warm the tortillas, in batches, for 30 secs each side or until warmed through.
